title: Paul McCartney live: Scandinavium, Gothenburg | 1993
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Scandinavium in Gothenburg, Sweden, on 25 September 1993.

It was the 48th night of the New World Tour, which lasted for 77 dates across 19 countries between February and December 1993.

McCartney’s band was Linda McCartney on vocals, keyboards, and percussion; Hamish Stuart on guitar, bass guitar, and vocals; Robbie McIntosh on guitar and vocals; Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens on keyboards and vocals; and Blair Cunningham on drums and percussion.

Wings had performed at the Scandinavium during the Wings Over Europe Tour on 10 August 1972. Paul McCartney returned there on 28 September 1989.
